style.backgroundSystem: deep grey-blue seamless studio backdrop alternating with light fog-grey bands and white rounded info cards

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial hardware ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep grey-blue backdrop #5C7F8E, light fog grey #F2F3F4, pure white cards #FFFFFF, and steel-blue accent #7FA8C9; cool neutral tone; modern geometric sans-serif type only; consistent rounded rectangular info cards with capsule labels and numbered circle markers; consistent two-tone flat line icons in #7FA8C9 and grey; brushed stainless-steel product rendering with crisp metallic highlights; stable product scale and centered placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: single hinge as hero, upright or diagonal stance on podium; consistent 3/4 hero angle across variant, comparison and CTA shots; stable scale and centered placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: matte grey-blue stepped geometric plinths and white circular display podiums
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; short Chinese headlines wrapped in 「」, small muted English caption rows only; no serif, handwriting or retro fonts
